formats.name: Wide Face portrait
formats.description: An extreme overhead ultra-wide portrait with natural skin detail. Use your chosen character and product with the camera look kept consistent.

formats.name: Scroll-stopping ads for cold audiences
formats.description: Each ad is 1 idea in 1 striking picture: a tiny diorama, a comic panel, a thermal image, a billboard. Made for people who have never heard of you.

formats.name: Proof ads
formats.description: Each ad is 1 kind of proof: a customer's own words, 1 number, your product against the usual way, the product labelled. For people who are comparing.

formats.name: Offer ads
formats.description: 1 offer argued 3 ways, because the person who needs proof is not the person who needs the deal: the deal said plainly, a real review, and why the product is worth it at full price. The offer line is its own text on every ad, so it changes on all of them at once.

formats.name: Ad from a review
formats.description: Ads built on 1 thing buyers keep saying, in their own words: the phrase on the picture character for character, in formats made to carry a quote (a taped note, a strikethrough, a Q and A card). The feed headline is the phrase.

formats.name: Recreate a winning ad
formats.description: Pick ads you like in the reference library, say what each should do, and the app builds yours on exactly those.

formats.name: Static ad from a script
formats.description: A script is written first, the way an ad argues in words, then 1 image carries that argument.

formats.name: Carousel
formats.description: 2 to 6 cards read in order: a list, a before and after, how it works. Each card does 1 job.

formats.name: Long-copy static
formats.description: A plain image with a long text beside it in the feed. For a buyer who needs the whole story before they click.

formats.name: Advertorial static
formats.description: An image that looks like the top of an article, leading to a page that tells the story.

formats.name: Native ad
formats.description: A long first-person story with an image that looks like a person's own post, not an ad.

formats.name: Instant photoshoot
formats.description: A whole shoot in 1 colour world: every picture shares 1 colour, 1 light and 1 set of props, so they look made in 1 afternoon.

formats.name: Flash photoshoot
formats.description: Pictures that look taken at a party on a small camera with the flash on: candid, warm, mid-action. Nobody looks at the camera.

formats.name: Cinematic film
formats.description: A photoreal film ad with consistent adult characters, matching scene coverage and a product-led payoff.

formats.name: New hooks for a winning ad
formats.description: Keep the ad that works and change only its first seconds. The app reads your ad, finds its hook, and writes new openings that cut onto the same body.

formats.name: Realistic AI video (UGC) · video
formats.description: A person talking to camera with your product, the way a customer would film it on their phone.

formats.name: AI podcast clip · video
formats.description: 2 people at microphones in a conversation that sounds overheard. Reads as content, not as an ad.

formats.name: Talking object · video
formats.description: An object from the buyer's life gets a face and says what it has watched. Funny or tender in the first second.

formats.name: Claymation story · video
formats.description: A narrated clay story about 1 small character. Good for a mechanism nobody can see.

formats.name: Comic style · video
formats.description: A comic page filmed on an artist's desk and read panel by panel.

formats.name: CGI explainer · video
formats.description: A narrated mini-documentary in rendered 3D, the kind that explains how something works inside the body or a machine.

formats.name: Satisfying hook and demo · video
formats.description: 4 to 5 wordless seconds in which the product does 1 motion that resolves, then its 1 action shown and said.

formats.name: Cinematic 3D film · video
formats.description: A short animated film that looks like a frame from a 3D feature, with light and materials like a photograph. For a story with people in it.

formats.name: Clay world · video
formats.description: A narrated story in a whole miniature clay world with a cast, in 1 of 4 looks: cinematic, goofy, clean or puppet. The look of a stop-motion film.

formats.name: Knitted wool world · video
formats.description: A narrated story in a miniature world knitted from yarn: the people, the room and your pack, all in stitches. Warm, and hard to scroll past.

formats.name: Paper world · video
formats.description: A narrated story in a world of cut, layered or folded paper, in 1 of 5 looks. A scene changes by a page turning or a layer peeling back.

formats.name: Watercolour story · video
formats.description: A narrated story painted in watercolour, where the paint itself moves: it blooms, bleeds and washes away. For a calm, natural or premium brand.

formats.name: Anime · video
formats.description: A drawn, animated ad with 1 original hero: a transformation, a big reveal, the old way against the new. In 1 of 5 drawn looks.

formats.name: Skeleton: what happens if · video
formats.description: A narrated "what happens if you..." journey, from Day 1 to Day 365, lived by 1 friendly cartoon skeleton. A question people stay to see answered.

formats.name: Motion graphics · video
formats.description: Moving type, diagrams, icons and cutouts of your product in your brand's colours. For a comparison, a number or how it works.

formats.name: Editorial collage explainer · video
formats.description: 1 argument explained fast with paper cutouts, photos of your product, arrows and labels over a narration. It reads as content, not as an ad.

formats.name: Song ad
formats.description: Your product sung: an original song about what your buyer gets, over an animated music video with 1 lead who sings on camera.

formats.name: Creator brief
formats.description: A brief a real creator can film from: the script, the shots, what to say and what not to say.

formats.name: Founder brief
formats.description: A script and shot notes for the founder to say to camera.

formats.name: Editor brief
formats.description: An edit brief with beat timings and visual notes for footage you already have.

formats.name: Organic: founder videos and creators
formats.description: What the brand posts as itself. 10 videos the founder films on a phone, 1 a week, each with a brief written for it; and a short list of the creators you send product to, with who posted and what to do next.
